app.name: OCPP Simulator
app.tagline: Simulate EV charge points against any OCPP CSMS

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Create simulated charge points, point them at your CSMS and drive them from the browser. Several chargers can stay connected at the same time.
dashboard.emptyDescription: Give it a name, enter your CSMS WebSocket URL and a charge point ID. It connects right away; no account or sign-in needed.

newCp.title: New charge point
newCp.description: The charger is stored in this browser and connects as soon as you create it.
newCp.name: Name
newCp.csmsUrlHint: WebSocket endpoint of your central system. The CP ID is appended to it.
newCp.invalidUrl: Must start with ws:// or wss://

cp.notFoundBody: The ID "{{id}}" was not found in your local state. Go back to the dashboard and select a charge point.
cp.seoDescription: Monitor and control OCPP charge point {{name}}. View real-time charging status, send OCPP messages, monitor network traffic, and manage charging sessions.
cp.seoKeywords: OCPP charge point, {{name}}, EV charging simulation, OCPP monitoring, charge point control
cp.deleteDescription: This will remove "{{label}}" and disconnect the simulated charge point.

controls.title: OCPP Controls
controls.connectionHint: Each status is sent to the selected connector and to connector 0 (the whole charge point) so the CSMS updates the global state, not just the initial one.
controls.transactionHint: Flow: Preparing → StartTx (Charging) → StopTx (Finishing → Available). StartTx only works with the connector in Preparing.
controls.activeTransaction: There is an active transaction on this connector. Stop it with StopTx before unplugging the cable.
controls.cablePlugged: Cable plugged into the vehicle (Preparing). You can start the session with StartTx.
controls.stateRequiredBody: The connector must be in Preparing (cable plugged into the car). Press "Preparing (plugged in)" before StartTx.
controls.txRejectedBody: The CSMS rejected the transaction (idTag status: {{status}}). The idTag must be accepted by the CSMS, so register it there as a valid ID tag.

deviceSettings.batteryStartDc: Controls the starting state-of-charge for DC charging simulations.
deviceSettings.batteryStartAc: Uses this value as the initial SoC reported in meter values.
deviceSettings.singleConnectorNote: Single connector configuration is fixed for this simulator.

ocppConfig.connectionDesc: Configure connection timing and heartbeat settings
ocppConfig.metersDesc: Configure meter value sampling and reporting
ocppConfig.sampledDataHint: Comma-separated list of measurands to sample
ocppConfig.alignedDataHint: Comma-separated list of measurands for clock-aligned data
ocppConfig.txDesc: Configure transaction behavior and stop conditions
ocppConfig.allowOfflineUnknown: Allow Offline Transactions for Unknown ID
ocppConfig.availabilityDesc: Configure connector availability and authorized ID tags
ocppConfig.noTags: No authorized ID tags. Click "{{action}}" to add one.
